title: #447 Successful Qualities
prompt: The qualities that a person needs to become truly successful cannot be learned at university or in a similar educational institution. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: The qualities that a person needs to become truly successful cannot be learned at university or in a similar educational institution.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Success requires personal skills that cannot be taught in school.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Success requires personal skills that cannot be taught in school.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Real-life experience provides important lessons for personal growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Real-life experience provides important lessons for personal growth.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Life experience, such as working in a team, teaches practical skills and how to interact with diverse people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Life experience, such as working in a team, teaches practical skills and how to interact with diverse people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Real life provides opportunities to solve problems, requiring quick thinking and innovative approaches that academic settings do not teach.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Real life provides opportunities to solve problems, requiring quick thinking and innovative approaches that academic settings do not teach.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Success requires practical life experience.

angles.en: The essay argues that success qualities are learned through practical experience and real-world challenges, not just through formal education.

angles.en: The essay uses examples like managing a team at work and starting a business to support the idea that life provides unique learning opportunities.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss whether success requires qualities that can't be learned in university.
keyArguments: Success requires qualities like self-discipline and emotional intelligence, which are not taught in universities.
Practical experience and real-world skills are crucial for success, which are often gained outside of formal education.
